purpose: Fail closed if any automatic Visual Fidelity critical-defect decision is omitted, duplicated, ambiguous, non-terminal, or inconsistent. Unity JsonUtility defaults a missing bool to false, so absence of an explicit present field must never be interpreted as defect absence.
failureInjection: Remove present from one criticalDefects object: validation must fail rather than allowing JsonUtility default false.
Duplicate present in one criticalDefects object: validation must fail.
Remove reviewStatus from one criticalDefects object: validation must fail.
Duplicate reviewStatus in one criticalDefects object: validation must fail.
Set reviewStatus to uncertain: validation must fail closed.
Set reviewStatus to unchecked: validation must fail closed.
Set present=true with reviewStatus=absent or present=false with reviewStatus=present: validation must fail.
Use an unknown critical-defect id or omit one canonical id: validation must fail.
note: This is evidence-integrity enforcement only. It awards zero Visual Fidelity points and cannot clear a critical defect. Real 3840x2160 Unity evidence, 100% crops, temporal evidence where applicable, and direct review remain mandatory.
